claims.claim: UK Used Sony PS4 Pro Console
claims.evidence: No brand/model text or PlayStation logo is legible in either photo; only a faint unidentified controller-style icon is visible.
Report explicitly notes no cables, controllers, power adapters, or original box are visible in either photo.
No document or receipt is shown in the photos.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired
claims.evidence: Internal seals/screws not visible; only external scuffs and scratches are shown.
Photos are static stills; no power-on test, port close-up, or video of operation is shown.

risks.risk: Unit may not be a PS4 Pro at all (model unconfirmed)
risks.proof: Clear photo of the rear/bottom label showing model number (CUH-7xxx series) and serial sticker
risks.if_unproven: priced as unidentified/generic console, not specifically PS4 Pro

risks.risk: No controller, cables, or power adapter actually included despite claim
risks.proof: A photo showing the controller, HDMI cable, and power brick laid out next to the console

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have internal faults (overheating, disc drive, HDMI port failure)
risks.proof: A short video of the console powering on to the home screen with fan/sound audible

risks.risk: Hidden repair or part-swap history despite 'never opened' claim
risks.proof: Close-up photo of screws for tamper seals/scratches around the casing seams

risks.risk: No proof of UK origin or purchase receipt
risks.proof: Clear photo of the actual receipt with matching serial number
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified origin, no provenance premium

risks.risk: Two units pictured but unclear if both are for sale or only one
risks.proof: Seller confirmation/photo clarifying how many units and listing price covers what
risks.if_unproven: priced as single unit unless proven otherwise

proof_requests: Photo of rear/bottom label with model number and serial
Photo of controller(s), cables, and power adapter laid out together
Short power-on video showing home screen and fan noise
Close-up of casing seams/screws for tamper signs
Photo of the actual UK receipt with matching serial
Clarification on whether one or two units are included in this sale
response.reason: The witness confirms a home gaming console (two units) with visible wear and no accessories, so it can be priced at worst case as an unverified, accessory-less, untested console pending the listed proofs.
